name: Advanced SQL & Database Internals
description: Advanced analytical querying, complex joins, window functions, recursive CTEs, query optimization, indexing strategies, and database execution internals.

subskills.name: Complex Joins, Sets & Correlated Subqueries
subskills.description: Inner, outer, cross, anti-joins, semi-joins, set operations (UNION, INTERSECT, EXCEPT), and correlated subquery optimization.

subskills.name: Window Functions & Analytical Aggregations
subskills.description: OVER clause, PARTITION BY, ORDER BY, framing (ROWS/RANGE BETWEEN), ranking (ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK), navigation (LEAD, LAG), and running aggregates.

subskills.name: Common Table Expressions & Recursive Queries
subskills.description: Modular CTEs, WITH clauses, recursive queries for hierarchical data traversal, and query modularity.

subskills.name: Indexing Strategies & Internal Structures
subskills.description: B-Tree, Hash, GiST, GIN, Bitmap indexes, composite indexes, covering indexes, partial indexes, and index selectivity.

subskills.name: Query Execution Plans & Cost-Based Optimization
subskills.description: Analyzing EXPLAIN / EXPLAIN ANALYZE, cost metrics, Seq Scan vs Index Scan, Hash Join vs Merge Join vs Nested Loop, and cardinality estimation.

subskills.name: Table Partitioning & Database Sharding
subskills.description: Range, List, and Hash partitioning, partition pruning, dynamic partition elimination, and horizontal sharding strategies.

subskills.name: Transactions, ACID Properties & Isolation Levels
subskills.description: ACID compliance, transaction management, isolation levels (Read Committed, Repeatable Read, Serializable), MVCC, and deadlocks.

subskills.name: Stored Procedures, Triggers & User-Defined Functions
subskills.description: PL/pgSQL, T-SQL, procedural control flow, triggers, table-valued functions, and custom SQL UDFs.

subskills.name: Database Performance Tuning & Statistics
subskills.description: ANALYZE, VACUUM, buffer cache hit ratio, connection pooling, temporary spill to disk, work_mem, and maintenance_work_mem tuning.

cv.signal: Optimized slow-running analytical SQL queries and database indexes

linkedin.signal: Endorsements for Advanced SQL, PostgreSQL, and Query Optimization

assessment.signal: Passes comprehensive Advanced SQL query and database optimization assessment

junior.description: Writes complex multi-table queries, analytical window functions, and recursive/modular CTEs.

mid.description: Designs indexing strategies, partitions large tables, manages transaction isolation levels, and writes stored procedures.

senior.description: Interprets complex EXPLAIN ANALYZE cost trees, tunes database memory/buffers, and resolves execution bottlenecks across distributed databases.
